name: Detonation at a Distance
summary: Sprite Jumpsprocket needs a safer way to set off explosives, and sends you to Stormwind Intelligence for a remote detonator.

sections.title: A Controlled Blast
sections.body: Volatile chemicals are handled recklessly by goblins and gnomes, though some blasts call for care. A standard fuse can put you in danger. Ordinary tinkerers do not keep the special trigger Sprite needs for a controlled explosion.

sections.title: Calling Upon the SI:7
sections.body: Sprite sends you to Stormwind Intelligence in Old Town, rather than to local dwarven blasters or ordinary engineering suppliers. Its agents, known as SI:7, work in sabotage, stealth, and targeted demolitions. Jasper Fel serves among them in the capital and can provide discreet, dangerous equipment.

faq.q: Who sends you on this mission?
aliases: who starts detonation at a distance
faq.answer: Sprite Jumpsprocket, a gnome tinkerer in Stormwind's Dwarven District, sends you to find a remote detonator.

faq.q: Who do you need to talk to in Stormwind?
faq.answer: Sprite sends you to Jasper Fel, an associate of Stormwind Intelligence in Stormwind.

faq.q: Why does Sprite Jumpsprocket need a remote detonator?
faq.answer: Sprite wants to set off explosives from a distance. A remote trigger is more practical than risking your limbs in an uncontrolled blast.

faq.q: Why contact Stormwind Intelligence rather than an engineer?
faq.answer: Stormwind Intelligence keeps specialized sabotage gear that ordinary merchants and field tinkerers do not stock or distribute openly.

faq.q: Where is Jasper Fel located in Stormwind?
faq.answer: Jasper Fel is at SI:7 headquarters in Old Town, where Stormwind's spies and covert agents work.

faq.q: What faction can undertake this task?
faq.answer: Only members of the Alliance can undertake this work. It depends on cooperation with Stormwind's royal intelligence division.

angles.text: As a rogue, you enter the heart of SI:7 operations in Old Town, where human covert tradecraft is practiced.
As an engineer, you can build fuses and dynamite. Military-grade remote triggers often come through contacts who specialize in quiet sabotage.
As a gnome, you share Sprite Jumpsprocket's interest in engineering problems. She turns to human intelligence for spycraft munitions.
